0022600027.text: Cleveland (4-4, 6th in the East and 2nd in the Central, 2 games back) hosts Philadelphia (8-1, 1st in the East and 1st in the Atlantic) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group B matchup, with the Cavaliers on a two-game losing streak and the 76ers riding a five-game winning streak. Cleveland is without Jarrett Allen (knee) and Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain), while Philadelphia is missing Adem Bona (back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), and Dominick Barlow (back fracture). The 76ers beat the Cavaliers 114-106 in Philadelphia on 2026-10-22, leaving Cleveland trailing 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after its 4-0 sweep in 2025-26.
